‹#›
TO CONSIDER

To talk about relationships among family members, we normally use the possessive case (‘s) which denotes belonging and possession and in this case states family relationships. 

There is more than one scenario for the possessive case:
a. Joe’s wife is a doctor. - One owner and one possession. 
b. Those are my aunt’s (kids). -  When the noun was already mentioned and we do not need to state again. 
c. This is Ted and Mary’s child. - Two owners - One possession.
d. These are Jake’s and Jill’s children - Two owners and two possessions.

When the noun finishes in ‘s’ we only add the (‘) and the end of the word. E.G. This is James’ child. When this happens, we add an extra syllable in spoken language that is pronounced /әz/. 

This is not only used to talk about family. E.G. Adrian’s car is blue. 

When we talk about objects or animals, it is common to use: The legs of the table / The tail of the cat. However, you may find examples using the (‘s).

texts: My name is Khai and I am from China. I am 26 years
old. I have a big family. My parents have six children,
three sons and three daughters. My siblings and I live
with them. I am the oldest. My sister Shinmei is the
second one. She is a science teacher at university and
she is 24 years old. Our brothers’ names are Tenkei
and Senku and our sisters’ names are Megumi and
Kumiko. My father is an only child so, we have no relatives on my father’s side. On my mother’s side, we have two uncles, three aunts and eleven cousins. See? We are a big family.
C. Read the following paragraph and state if the sentences are true (T) or false (F). After that, read the paragraph aloud to your teacher.
1.   His name is Kite.				T    F
2.  He has a small family.			T    F
3.  His parents have six children.		T    F
4.  He has four siblings.			T    F
5.  He is the oldest son.			   T    F
6.  Shinmei is Khai’s mother.			   T    F
7.  Tenkei and Senku are Khai’s brothers.   T    F
8.   He has no relatives.			    T    F

texts: My name is Khai and I am from China. I am 26 years
old. I have a big family. My parents have six children,
three sons and three daughters. My siblings and I live
with them. I am the oldest. My sister Shinmei is the

and Senku and our sisters’ names are Megumi and

shapes.joinedText:
Khai’s Family 

My name is Khai and I am from China. I am 26 years 
old. I have a big family. My parents have six children, 
three sons and three daughters. My siblings and I live 
with them. I am the oldest. My sister Shinmei is the 
second one. She is a science teacher at university and 
she is 24 years old. Our brothers’ names are Tenkei 
and Senku and our sisters’ names are Megumi and 
Kumiko. My father is an only child so, we have no relatives on my father’s side. On my mother’s side, we have two uncles, three aunts and eleven cousins. See? We are a big family.

published.title: Khai’s Family My name is Khai and I am from China. I am 26 years old. I have a big family. My parents have six children, three sons and three daughters. My siblings and I live with them. I am the oldest. My sister Shinmei is the second one. She is a science teacher at university and she is 24 years old. Our brothers’ names are Tenkei and Senku and our sisters’ names are Megumi and Kumiko. My father is an only child so, we have no relatives on my father’s side. On my mother’s side, we have two uncles, three aunts and eleven cousins. See? We are a big family.
